meaning: Am tells about yourself right now.
usage: Use am with the word I.

meaning: I means yourself — the person speaking.
usage: Say I when you talk about yourself.

meaning: Can means you are able to do something.
usage: Use can before an action word like run or jump.

meaning: We means you and other people together.
usage: Say we when you mean a group that includes you.

meaning: The points to one special thing we already know.
usage: Use the before a noun like cat, ball, or book.

meaning: Like means you enjoy something.
usage: Say I like when something makes you happy.

meaning: A means one of something.
usage: Use a before a word that starts with a consonant sound.

meaning: See means to look with your eyes.
usage: Use see when you spot something with your eyes.

meaning: Go means to move from one place to another.
usage: Use go when you leave to visit a place.

meaning: To shows where you are going or what you want.
usage: Use to before an action or a place.

meaning: Have means you own or hold something.
usage: Say I have when something belongs to you.

meaning: Is tells about one person, animal, or thing.
usage: Use is with he, she, it, or one name.

meaning: Play means to have fun and enjoy games.
usage: Use play when you do something fun.

meaning: Are tells about more than one person or thing.
usage: Use are with we, you, or they.

meaning: For shows who something is meant for.
usage: Use for when you give something to someone.

meaning: You means the person you are talking to.
usage: Say you when you speak to another person.

meaning: On means something is touching the top of a surface.
example: The cat is on the mat.
usage: Use on when something sits above something else.

meaning: In means something is inside a place.
example: The ball is in the box.
usage: Use in when something is within a space.

meaning: So can mean very or because of that.
usage: Use so to make a feeling stronger.

meaning: This points to something close to you.
usage: Point and say this for something near you.

meaning: And joins two things together.
usage: Use and to connect two words or ideas.

meaning: What asks for information or a name.
usage: Start a question with what when you want to know something.

meaning: It means one thing or animal.
usage: Use it for one object or animal.

meaning: At shows a place or time.
usage: Use at when you point to a spot or moment.

meaning: Do helps ask or tell about an action.
usage: Use do at the start of a yes-or-no question.

meaning: An means one of something.
usage: Use an before a word that starts with a vowel sound.

meaning: No means not yes or not any.
usage: Say no when you refuse or disagree politely.

meaning: Up means toward a higher place.
usage: Use up when you rise or look higher.

meaning: Little means small in size.
usage: Use little to describe something small.

meaning: Said means spoke words in the past.
usage: Use said when someone already talked.

meaning: Here means in this place.
usage: Say here when you want someone close to you.

meaning: Was tells about something in the past.
usage: Use was with one person or thing in the past.

meaning: She means one girl or woman.
usage: Use she for a female person.

meaning: He means one boy or man.
usage: Use he for a male person.

meaning: Has means someone owns or holds something.
usage: Use has with he, she, or it.

meaning: Look means to use your eyes on purpose.
usage: Say look when you want someone to see something.

meaning: With means together or using something.
usage: Use with when you are not alone.

meaning: My shows something belongs to me.
usage: Say my before things that are yours.

meaning: Me means yourself when someone does something to you.
usage: Use me after words like give, tell, or help.

meaning: Where asks about a place.
usage: Start a question with where to find a place.

meaning: Went means moved in the past.
usage: Use went when go already happened.

meaning: Get means to receive or fetch something.
usage: Use get when you pick up or receive something.

meaning: Come means to move toward the speaker.
usage: Say come when you want someone to move to you.

meaning: Got means received something in the past.
usage: Use got when you already have something.

meaning: Had means owned or felt something in the past.
usage: Use had when something was true before.

meaning: They means more than one person or thing.
usage: Use they for a group of people or things.

meaning: Will means something will happen later.
usage: Use will to talk about the future.

meaning: Too means also or very much.
usage: Say too when you feel the same as someone else.

meaning: All means every one with nothing left out.
usage: Use all when you mean the whole group.

meaning: Be means to exist or act in a certain way.
usage: Use be after please or can.

meaning: As can compare two things.
example: Run as fast as you can.
usage: Use as…as to show sameness.

meaning: Ball is a round toy you can throw or kick.
usage: Say ball when you play with a round toy.

meaning: By can mean next to or before a time.
usage: Use by when something is beside you.

meaning: Day is the time when the sun is out.
usage: Use day when you talk about daytime.

meaning: Did helps talk about the past.
usage: Use did in past questions.

meaning: Not makes a sentence negative.
usage: Put not after am, is, or are to say no.

meaning: Her means belonging to a girl or woman.
usage: Use her for a female person.

meaning: Him means a boy or man receiving an action.
usage: Use him after verbs like tell or help.

meaning: Fun means something enjoyable.
usage: Say fun when you enjoy an activity.

meaning: Eat means to put food in your mouth.
usage: Use eat when you have food.

meaning: If starts a condition — when one thing depends on another.
usage: Use if to say something happens only when another thing is true.

meaning: Jump means to push off the ground with your feet.
usage: Use jump when you leap into the air.

meaning: Man means an adult male person.
usage: Use man for a grown-up male.

meaning: Or gives a choice between two things.
usage: Use or when you pick one of two options.

meaning: Put means to place something somewhere.
usage: Say put when you set something down.

meaning: Mom means your mother.
usage: Say mom when you talk about your mother.

meaning: Out means away from the inside.
usage: Use out when you leave a room or house.

meaning: Now means at this moment.
usage: Say now when you mean right away.

meaning: Of shows what something is made from or part of.
usage: Use of to connect two nouns.

meaning: Yes means you agree.
usage: Say yes when you accept or agree.

meaning: Ran means moved fast on foot in the past.
usage: Use ran when run already happened.

meaning: Sat means rested on a chair in the past.
usage: Use sat when sit already happened.

meaning: Read means to look at words in a book.
usage: Use read when you look at written words.

meaning: Run means to move fast on your feet.
usage: Use run when you move quickly.

meaning: Sit means to rest on a chair or floor.
usage: Say sit when you want someone to take a seat.

meaning: Then means what happens next.
usage: Use then to show the order of events.

meaning: His shows something belongs to a boy or man.
usage: Use his before things that belong to him.

meaning: Say means to speak words.
usage: Use say when you tell someone to speak.

meaning: Us means me and others receiving an action.
usage: Use us after verbs like help or join.

meaning: Them means more than one person or thing receiving an action.
usage: Use them after verbs like give or see.

meaning: Saw means looked with your eyes in the past.
usage: Use saw when see already happened.

meaning: Girl means a young female child.
usage: Use girl for a young female person.

meaning: How asks about the way something happens.
usage: Start a question with how to learn the way.

meaning: When asks about time.
usage: Use when to ask about time.

meaning: Your shows something belongs to the listener.
usage: Say your when something belongs to the person you talk to.

meaning: About means on the topic of something.
usage: Use about when you discuss a topic.

meaning: From shows where something starts.
usage: Use from to show a starting place.

meaning: Than compares two things.
usage: Use than after bigger, smaller, or more.

meaning: Away means far from here.
usage: Use away when something moves to a distance.

meaning: Came means moved toward a place in the past.
usage: Use came when come already happened.

meaning: Could means was able to in the past.
usage: Use could for ability in the past.

meaning: Big means large in size.
usage: Use big to describe something large.

meaning: Been goes with have to show a past visit or state.
usage: Use been after have or has.

meaning: After means later than something else.
usage: Use after to show what comes next in time.

meaning: Who asks about a person.
usage: Start a question with who to name a person.

meaning: Back means returning to a place.
usage: Use back when someone returns.

meaning: I'm is a short way to say I am.
usage: Use I'm when you talk about yourself quickly.

meaning: Because gives a reason.
usage: Use because to explain why.

meaning: Very makes a word stronger.
usage: Put very before a describing word.

meaning: Over can mean above or finished.
usage: Use over when you go across something.
